entries.en: Wanna see your menu.
Could use a drink.
I'll have a drink.
What kinds of wines do you have?
Throat's feelin' parched. What've you got?
What kinds of wines do you have?
Maybe I didn't drink Champaradise every day, but Chateau Piquette was all the rage back in Arasaka.
entries.ro: Poate nu beam Champaradise în fiecare zi, dar Chateau Piquette era pe val pe vremea Arasaka.

entries.en: We cater to the cream of the corporate elite. I believe our wines would be sliiightly beyond your price range.
entries.ro: Servim crema elitei corporatiste. Cred că vinurile noastre sunt ușooor peste bugetul tău.

entries.en: By the looks of you, I doubt their names would tell you anything.
entries.ro: După cum arăți, mă îndoiesc că numele lor ți-ar spune ceva.

entries.en: We had good wine at Arasaka.
Oh! Uh... p-please forgive me – a misunderstanding, that's all! Would you like to see the wine list?
entries.ro: A! Ăă... t-te rog, scuze – a fost o neînțelegere, atât! Vrei să vezi lista de vinuri?

entries.en: I'll take something to drink.
How long've you run this place?
entries.ro: De cât timp conduci locul ăsta?

entries.en: Take something to drink.
How long've you been runnin' this place?
entries.ro: De cât timp conduci locul ăsta?

entries.en: Right away, miss. Arasaka clients are our always first priority.
entries.en_m: Right away, sir. Arasaka clients are always our first priority.
entries.ro: Imediat, domnișoară. Clienții Arasaka au mereu prioritate.
entries.ro_m: Imediat, domnule. Clienții Arasaka au mereu prioritate.

entries.en: Long as I can remember... Grandad opened the original merchant's back in Cambridge, and then father brought it here – to Night City.
entries.ro: Din câte-mi amintesc... Bunicu' a deschis prima prăvălie la Cambridge, apoi tata a adus-o aici, în Night City.

entries.en: [Drink]
[Step away from bar]
[Sit at bar] Could use a drink.
entries.ro: [Stai la bar] Mi-ar prinde bine o băutură.
